_doc: Per-follow-up citation override. The renderer falls back to the SCENARIO's coach cite when a follow-up carries none (assets/study.js: fu.cite || sc.coach.cite), so a follow-up whose debrief walks a different part shows a 'Where it lives' line pointing at a part that debrief never mentions. Keys are scenario id -> follow-up index -> cite string. The build resolves each into links with the same cite_links() the coach cites use, and FATALs if one resolves to nothing, so an unresolvable cite cannot ship.
